input: Run a KYC screen on Binance in France

output.risk_rationale: As of 2026-11-04, the risk rating is high because of the investor complaint and French money-laundering/licensing investigation described in adverse_media; these are allegations and investigations, not established convictions. The legal entity is active, but its LEI registration is lapsed. The documented ownership chain identifies Intercorp Holdco SAS as the direct shareholder and Yulong Yan and Lihua He as equal indirect owners, although the restricted beneficial-owner register was not independently inspected. OFAC and UK checks produced no confirmed exact-name match; these are limited name-based results, not comprehensive clearance. EU screening remains inconclusive. No substantiated PEP flag was identified, which is not equivalent to PEP clearance. Three findings were excluded from attribution: the foreign Binance Holdings Ltd. OFAC settlement, the Mexican INTERCORP LEGOCA sanctions namesake, and a January 2025 platform-level investigation whose source did not expressly identify this French legal entity. Missing_fields: people[*].nationality; independently verified beneficial-owner-register entries; complete supervisory-board membership; current disposition of the French proceedings; sanctions[2].match. Registration distinguishes entity creation from first registry registration.
